description: Adds a sequence to the Adobe Media Encoder render queue.

allowOverwrite.description: Allow writing to an existing output file. Defaults to false.

presetName.description: Exact user preset display name or filename stem. Must resolve to exactly one discovered .epr preset.

removeOnCompletion.description: Pass AME removeOnCompletion. Defaults to true.

sequenceId.description: The ID of the sequence to render. Defaults to the active sequence.

sourceRange.description: Export source range. Defaults to entire.

startImmediately.description: Whether to start rendering immediately (default: false)

name: add_to_render_queue
